comment: The hostname or IP address of the OpenSearch server used for catalog search.
modal: The address Magento connects to when indexing and querying catalog search. Applies only when the search engine is set to OpenSearch.

comment: The port on which the OpenSearch server accepts connections.
modal: The TCP port used to reach the OpenSearch server. Applies only when the search engine is set to OpenSearch.

comment: A prefix added to OpenSearch index names for this installation.
modal: Prepended to the names of the catalog search indexes, letting several installations share one OpenSearch cluster without clashing. Applies only when the search engine is set to OpenSearch.

comment: Whether to send HTTP authentication credentials when connecting to OpenSearch.
modal: When **Yes**, Magento authenticates to OpenSearch using the configured username and password. Applies only when the search engine is set to OpenSearch.

comment: The username for HTTP authentication to OpenSearch.
modal: The user name used to authenticate to the OpenSearch server. Applies only when the engine is OpenSearch and **Enable OpenSearch HTTP Auth** is set to Yes.

comment: The password for HTTP authentication to OpenSearch.
modal: The password used to authenticate to the OpenSearch server. Applies only when the engine is OpenSearch and **Enable OpenSearch HTTP Auth** is set to Yes.

comment: The request timeout for connections to the OpenSearch server.
modal: How long Magento waits for an OpenSearch request before timing out. Applies only when the search engine is set to OpenSearch.
